signal: Agreed to buy Zscaler, a named Avante customer, in an all-stock deal worth about $43.9B; expected to close in the second half of fiscal 2028.
why_icp: Two large tech workforces, two benefits programs, and a long runway before close. The benefits team will have to compare plans, vendors and costs side by side, and Zscaler already runs on Avante.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Global Benefits or VP Total Rewards
first_line: Big news with Zscaler. Lining up two benefits programs before close is a lot of plan-by-plan comparison.

signal: Completed its acquisition of Roku; expects about $400M in run-rate cost synergies within two years.
why_icp: Deal is closed and synergy targets are public, so benefits costs will be on the table. A media company absorbing a tech workforce with different benefits expectations.
suggested_contact_title: SVP Total Rewards or Head of Benefits
first_line: Congrats on closing Roku. With $400M in synergies to find, benefits will be one of the bigger line items to compare.

signal: Completed its roughly $1.055B acquisition of Brakebush Brothers, with plants in Wisconsin, North Carolina, Texas, Minnesota and Georgia.
why_icp: Large frontline workforce across five states joining a much bigger food company. Employees will have a lot of questions about what changes in their coverage.
suggested_contact_title: Director of Benefits or VP Human Resources
first_line: Saw the Brakebush close. Plant teams in five states will have a lot of questions about their benefits.

signal: Agreed to acquire Willow Run Foods (closing expected January); plans to keep Willow Run employees. McLane employs 25,000+ people.
why_icp: Employee-owned company joining a 25,000-person distributor, with a close date already set. A clear window to plan the benefits move.
suggested_contact_title: VP Total Rewards or Benefits Manager
first_line: Saw the Willow Run Foods deal. Moving an employee-owned team onto McLane benefits is a big change for those employees.

signal: Completed its acquisition of CIRCOR Aerospace, adding about $270M in annual sales.
why_icp: Closed yesterday. An aerospace manufacturing workforce joining a global industrial, with benefits that will need to be lined up.
first_line: Congrats on closing CIRCOR Aerospace. The benefits side of integration usually starts right about now.

signal: Completed its acquisition of Everlight Radiology.
why_icp: Healthcare employer adding clinicians. Clinical staff tend to care a lot about benefits details, and questions spike right after a close.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Benefits or Chief People Officer
first_line: Saw the Everlight close. New radiologists joining will want clear answers on their benefits fast.

signal: Signed a definitive agreement to acquire Boone Health.
why_icp: Hospital system adding a health system. Large clinical and support workforce, and the deal still has to close, so there is time to plan.
first_line: Saw the Boone Health agreement. There is still time before close to map out how the two benefits programs fit together.

why_icp: Global services firm adding an engineering services team. Avante pitches itself as built for global benefits teams, which is this exact problem.
first_line: Congrats on closing Wizeline. Folding in a new team makes benefits a lot harder to compare side by side.

signal: Completed its acquisition of Murphy Corporation, adding a skilled union workforce.
why_icp: Union workforce means plan rules and contracts that differ from the rest of the company. Good test of contract-versus-claims checks.
suggested_contact_title: VP Benefits or Director of HR Operations
first_line: Saw the Murphy close. Union benefit plans next to company plans is a lot of documents to keep straight.

signal: Completed its $325M cash acquisition of Level AI.
why_icp: Smaller deal, but a tech company adding an AI team it wants to keep. Retention makes benefits a sensitive part of the integration.
first_line: Congrats on closing Level AI. Keeping that team happy through the switch usually comes down to the details, benefits included.
